name: leafwiki-coordinated-cancellation-for-7095
instr:
wiki cannot currently identify and cancel specific backup, snapshot, and restore runs without risking replacement work. Implement consistent run identity and cancellation across managers, authenticated HTTP operations, and browser clients without changing existing behavior.

Every accepted trigger must return a distinct, non-empty identifier through its first terminal status. Each manager exposes at most one current run; rejected overlaps cannot replace its identifier or take cancellation ownership. Cancellation reports accepted, already_finished, stale, or unsafe deterministically, and only the first matching request is accepted. Cancellation and completion select one immutable terminal outcome. Keep registry ownership until the worker exits, and make shutdown wait for all workers and mutable resources to be released.

Status responses add nullable current-run and last-run cancellation information while preserving backup fields, snapshot ordering and metadata, restore rejection effects, localized errors, zero-value omissions, and administrative authentication behavior. `github.com/perber/wiki/internal/operations` exports `RunID`, `CancelOutcome`, `RunRef`, `CancelResult`, `CancelRequest`, and `Registry`; `RunRef` has `ID` as "id" and `Cancellable` as "cancellable", `CancelResult` has `RunID` as "runId" and `Outcome` as "outcome", and `CancelRequest` has `RunID` as "runId". `RunID` and `CancelOutcome` are string types, with `CancelAccepted = "accepted"`, `CancelAlreadyFinishe
